questions.q: Core: A(1, 1), B(7, 5). Find (a) the midpoint (b) the gradient of AB (c) the equation of AB (d) the line through B perpendicular to AB
Extend : L1 is y = 2x − 2. L2 is perpendicular to L1 and passes through (4, 1). Find where L2 crosses the x-axis.
Stretch : Find the area of the triangle formed by L1, L2 and the y-axis.
questions.a: Lines meet where 2x − 2 = −0.5x + 3, x = 2; y-intercepts −2 and 3, base 5; area = ½ × 5 × 2 = 5

questions.q: Find the line parallel to 3x + y = 7 through (2, 1).

questions.a: Yes: the gradients 0.5 and −2 multiply to −1

questions.q: Where does y = 3x − 6 cross the x-axis?
